modelContextSummary: Bounded direct Logic 12.3 build-6674 Compressor evidence at 48 kHz/PCM24 extends the frozen controlled Platinum curve. Continuous 1 kHz steps separated attack 0/50 ms and release 51/490 ms; matched controls distinguished Platinum and Vintage VCA/FET/Opto. All admitted state pairs were PCM-identical after transition exclusion. Left-only Max versus Sum differed by 4.54587 dB; an asymmetric probe showed the same linked gain on the low-level opposite channel. Vintage Opto displayed state and PCM survived reload exactly. Header bypass matched the source on both output channels, and settled re-enable restored exact pre-bypass PCM. Other circuits, RMS, auto gain/release, side-chain filters/external side chain, distortion, limiter, mix, grids, rates, automation, latency/tail, listening, private topology, and TrackSmith Logic authority remain unproven or prohibited.

nativeState.importantInterpretation: These are bounded directly observed Logic 12.3 states. They are not a claim about Apple's private topology, every parameter combination, or TrackSmith authority to control Logic.

input.sourceUnchangedEvidence: Every source copy is hash-ledgered. The mono v2 ballistics fixture preserved the v1 file hash, and two independent v2 generations reproduced every v2 byte.

renderMethod.logicCommand: File > Bounce > Project or Section using the active cycle range
renderMethod.renderSchedulingBoundary: Logic exposed Automatic in the bounce dialog; no realtime/offline scheduling claim is made.
renderMethod.settlingRule: Preserve first-transition output, then require repeated decoded-PCM identity before making settled-state claims.
renderMethod.baselineGate: The header-bypass state had to reproduce the mono source sample-exactly on both interleaved output channels.

documented_default_and_bypass_path.evidence: Vintage Opto header bypass produced two PCM-identical renders whose two output channels each matched the mono source sample-exactly. Re-enable preserved one 479-frame first transition, then exactly restored the accepted pre-bypass PCM.

every_discrete_mode_model_algorithm_and_.evidence: Platinum Digital plus Vintage VCA, FET, and Opto were rendered at matched displayed controls. Studio VCA/FET and Classic VCA were not rendered. Max and Sum were rendered; external side-chain routing was not.

bounded_continuous_parameter_grid_with_i.evidence: One ten-level static curve, two displayed attack states, two displayed release states, and four circuits at matched controls were measured. Threshold, ratio, knee, makeup, and cross-parameter grids remain unknown.

reported_and_measured_latency_polarity_g.evidence: Gain, peak, per-channel identity/polarity, frame counts, and zero-lag comparisons are artifact-backed. Dedicated impulse latency and tail tests were not run for this bounded Compressor profile.

three_identical_renders_for_repeatabilit.evidence: Every newly admitted state has at least two decoded-PCM-identical settled renders. A three-render requirement was not completed for every state.

save_reload_state_and_source_hash_verifi.evidence: Threshold, ratio, attack, release, makeup, knee, circuit, detector, gains, mix, filter, limiter, and auto controls were visibly identical after reload. Two post-reload renders were PCM-identical to one another and to the accepted pre-save render.

threshold_ratio_knee_static_curve_makeup.evidence: The controlled Platinum curve captured ten input levels at threshold -20 dB, ratio 4.1:1, knee 0, makeup 0, Auto Gain off. Header bypass was sample-exact, but broader threshold/ratio/knee/makeup/Auto Gain and perceptual level-matching grids remain unrun.

attack_release_auto_release_overshoot_re.evidence: The continuous-phase level-step fixture separated displayed 0 and 50 ms attack and displayed 51 and 490 ms release, with 10 ms gain windows and a declared 0.5 dB settling rule. Auto Release, program dependence, pumping, and musical-source behavior remain unknown.

peak_rms_detector_sidechain_filter_and_e.evidence: Peak detection with internal Max and Sum was measured. RMS, side-chain filters, and external side chain were not run.

seven_circuit_models_distortion_modes_li.evidence: Platinum Digital and Vintage VCA/FET/Opto were compared with distortion and limiter off at Mix 100%. The remaining circuits and active distortion, limiter, and parallel-mix states remain unknown.

stereo_max_sum_link_left_right_asymmetry.evidence: Left-only Max and Sum each repeated PCM-exactly; Sum was 4.545870 dB higher in least-squares gain than Max and neither created right-channel crossfeed. With the right held at -30 dBFS, left-driven Max gain reduction matched on both channels to within approximately 0.000003 dB. Other stereo fixtures and mono translation remain outside this bounded result.

transient_sustain_noise_low_end_and_sour.evidence: Generated noise, stereo, and musically structured fixtures are retained for later work, but no participant completed a controlled listening protocol and no preference claim is made.

measurements.measurementBoundary: All values describe only the exact recorded states, fixtures, environment, and analysis rules. They neither identify Apple's private implementation nor prove musical usefulness.

stateTransitionFindings: Vintage VCA and Vintage FET produced PCM-identical first and second captured renders after selection.
Vintage Opto's first captured post-selection render differed from the next render only in the first 3782 samples; the next two renders were PCM-identical and form the accepted settled state.
Vintage Opto save/reload reopened the exact displayed values and produced PCM identical to the accepted pre-save state.
Header bypass produced source-exact PCM on both output channels.
The first render after re-enabling Vintage Opto differed in 459 samples ending at frame 478; the next render exactly restored the pre-bypass accepted PCM.

excludedAttempts.reason: Retained as the first post-circuit transition. It is excluded from settled-repeat and reload claims because it differs from the next render in 3398 samples through frame 3781.
Retained as the first post-bypass re-enable transition. It is excluded from restored-state claims because it differs from the accepted settled state in 459 samples through frame 478.

measuredBehavior: The recorded Platinum Digital state remained unity through the -24 dBFS amplitude-ladder segment, then produced progressively more gain reduction through -1 dBFS.
At fixed displayed controls, 50 ms attack delayed measured gain settling relative to 0 ms, and 490 ms release delayed recovery relative to 51 ms.
The four tested circuit states did not share one static or dynamic result at matched displayed controls.
Max and Sum produced materially different gain on the left-only probe, while the asymmetric probe directly demonstrated linked gain movement on the opposite channel.
The accepted Vintage Opto state was exactly recoverable after save/reload and after the bounded bypass transition.
inferredConsequences: Typed production knowledge may treat circuit, detector routing, timing, and transition state as consequential; it must not assume displayed values are interchangeable between circuit types.
Preview comparison should settle or explicitly expose a first-transition render before presenting an exact repeatability claim.
Stereo preservation checks should include both crossfeed and linked-gain behavior rather than relying on a control label.
professionalPracticeHeuristics: Attack, release, detector, and circuit choices remain source- and goal-dependent.
Static curves and tone-step settling are guardrails for candidate design, not a ranking of musical quality.
prohibitedOverclaims: No tested circuit is declared universally superior, faster-sounding, punchier, warmer, or more musical.
No private detector, envelope, circuit, or smoothing topology is identified.
No untested Compressor control, circuit, sample rate, channel format, automation path, or musical source is generalized.
No TrackSmith authority to inspect, insert, reorder, automate, or control Logic Compressor is granted.

listeningBoundary.statement: No participant completed a controlled listening test for this run. Objective behavior is not represented as preference or musical usefulness.

claimBoundary.boundedProfileAcceptance: This run is sufficient for the milestone's bounded Compressor production profile because it materially covers a controlled static curve, attack/release behavior, four high-value circuits, stereo Max/Sum and linked/asymmetric behavior, repeatability, bypass/restoration, and save/reload. It remains partial in the exhaustive campaign.
